patthana15.52:1.1: noupādānaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no upādāno nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. noupādānaṃ
patthana15.52:2.1: akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no upādāno na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. kilesagocchakaduka kusalattike nokilesagocchakaduka nakusalattikaṃ
patthana15.52:3.1: nokilesaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no kileso na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. dassanenapahātabbaduka kusalattike nadassanenapahātabbaduka nakusalattikaṃ
